lane: Concurrent release labels, upload-set indexes, OCR handoff snapshots, and source-authority conflicts
publication_decision: Pending workflow DOI refresh. This is reusable workflow/support documentation, not author-edition material.

local_files.scope: Workflow addendum from Noether maintenance: web/session release-label ownership, local after_Web/on_Current naming, current upload-set index discipline, pending-queue caveat audits, OCR handoff snapshots as locator evidence, and no-promoted-patch handling for source-authority conflicts.

lessons: Do not reuse bare R-number release labels across independent agents or local support packages.
A small upload-set index can be more useful than a large unlabelled pile of support ZIPs.
Pending Zenodo manifests should be machine-audited for parseability, duplicate artifact names, target DOI/record clarity, artifact role, and explicit caveats before public action.
OCR/Marker handoffs are source-locator evidence unless page-specific source comparison promotes their text.
Original-publication versus collected-volume conflicts may legitimately produce a no-promoted-patch package.
Support/provenance packages should not be fronted as reader editions or critical-edition evidence.
caveat: Workflow/support artifact only. This does not certify Noether or any author record.
next_action: Include this addendum in the next deliberate workflow DOI refresh and, if practical, bundle it with the existing compact workflow addenda ZIP.
